steps.title: Housing: extrude the collar
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as housing.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane. Draw a circle 110 diameter on the origin.

steps.title: Housing: the bore, 80 H7
actions: Hole: Placement = Concentric on the end face, Simple hole, diameter 80, Through All.
Tolerance: in the Hole dialog (or on the drawing) set the fit class H7: hole 80.000 to 80.030. The model is made at the nominal 80; the limits go on the drawing.

steps.title: Housing: chamfer the bore
actions: Chamfer: Distance 1, select both bore edges (a lead in for the shaft). OK. Save.

steps.title: Shaft: extrude 80 s6
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as shaft.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane. Draw a circle 80 diameter.
Tolerance: s6, so the shaft 80.059 to 80.078. Modelled at the nominal 80.

steps.title: Shaft: chamfer the lead end
actions: Chamfer: Distance 1.5, select the circular edge at the lead end. OK. Save.

steps.title: Assemble: shaft into housing
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as fit_interference.iam.
Constrain: Insert, the shaft chamfer edge to the bore edge, offset 20 (half way in). OK.

Inspect tab > Analyze Interference shows none, because both parts are at the nominal size. The real fit (interference) comes from the tolerances: use Design tab > Limits/Fits Mechanical to check it. Save.
